summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K to inform shareholders of the monetary adjustment and payment of the first installment of shareholder remuneration related to the 2025 fiscal year, specifically interest on capital for the fourth quarter of 2025. The payment will be made on May 20, 2026, for common shareholders with a record date of April 22, 2026, and on May 28, 2026, for ADR holders. The gross value per share is adjusted by the Selic rate. This is a routine dividend/interest on capital payment, not a special situation event.
